needs.what: a residual-gate claimant for a PERMANENT card's printed "Foretell {cost}" line: verify._covered should claim it when the card-level `foretell` field is set and its cost matches the printed cost exactly (the strict _declares_printed_cost shape warp, mutate and mayhem use)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The card-level `foretell` field exists and the engine implements the special action and the cast from exile, but `foretell` is not in KNOWN_KEYWORDS and verify._covered has no foretell branch, so the line is only consumed on instants and sorceries (whose spell_effects claim every line). A creature declaring foretell "{4}{U}" was rejected at gate 3 with residual exactly "Foretell {4}{U}" (checked with --collect --dry-run). The other two lines are expressible: the flying keyword, and a spell_cost_reduction static with affects_spells {controller: you, not_from_zone: hand} as shipped on Advanced Reconstruction.
